data.gender_notes: Nibaal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-b-l', meaning 'lion'. The name Nibaal is a symbol of strength, courage, and bravery in Islamic culture. The name Nibaal carries the meaning “Lion, Courageous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nibaal usually hope their child will grow to embody lion, courageous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the spirit of courage and resilience, cherished in the Islamic faith.
data.etymology: Nibaal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion, Courageous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nibaal total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
